description: G2 truth table for the pinned Eino workflow probe graph. Topology: START fans out to a, b and c; join ANDs a+b; sw switches on input.port; port p1 owns region {p1a, p1b}, port p2 owns {p2a}; sel converges p1b|p2a; mix illegally ANDs p1b with unconditional c to document the skipped-dependency hazard; exits are sel and a. Observed on v0.9.13: a node with no path to END races run settlement — mix and c sometimes execute, sometimes are cut off; only END-ancestral nodes are awaited. Deterministic assertions therefore cover execution/skip only for END-reachable nodes, plus 'skipped predecessors never supply data' whenever mix does run.
